title: 第21章 对战一号沈千尘
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
安怜听到这个名字，愣了一下。

    周秀兰？不就是昨天排在她前面老太太吗？

    她感知到老太太颤颤巍巍地走上台，把手放在水晶上。

    水晶亮起微弱的光，陈序报出数字：“周秀兰，魔力值一千二。”

    全场又是一阵骚动。

    不是惊叹，而是议论。

    “一千二也来参加选拔赛？”

    “这不是浪费名额吗？”

    “这么大年纪了，在家歇着不好吗？”

    安怜听着周围的议论声，心里不太舒服。

    一千二怎么了？一千二就不能追求梦想了？

    周秀兰倒是不在意，颤颤巍巍地走下台，经过安怜身边时，又拍了拍她的手臂，说了句“加油”。

    安怜对她说了声“谢谢”，心里涌起一股说不清的情绪。

    “二十四号，安怜。”

    安怜深吸一口气，站起来，凭着记忆和感知往台上走。

    走到台中央，她伸手摸到测试水晶的位置，将手掌贴了上去。

    魔力从掌心涌出，水晶亮起温暖的光芒。

    陈序看了一眼数字：“安怜，魔力值六千三。”

    六千三，比她预想的还要高一点。

    安怜收回手，转身准备下台。

    “等一下。”陈序叫住她。

    安怜停下来，侧头朝着他的方向：“考官有事吗？”

    陈序看了她一眼，欲言又止，最后还是摆了摆手：“没事，你下去吧。”

    安怜虽然疑惑，但也没多想，走下台回到自己的位置。

    魔力测试结束后是封印术实操。

    选手们被带到训练场旁边的一间大教室里，每人面前摆着一张桌子和一套封印阵绘制工具。

    陈序站在讲台上，宣布考题：“基础封印阵，阵型不限，要求魔力回路完整，节点清晰，运行稳定。限时三十分钟，现在开始。”

    安怜拿起笔，努力回忆封印阵的绘制要点。

    先画阵基，再布节点，最后连通魔力回路。

    感知能力在此时发挥了作用，她清晰地“看到”笔尖在纸上的轨迹，每一根线条的位置和走向都精确到毫米。

    画完阵基，她开始布节点。

    她小心地把每一个节点放置在正确的位置上，然后用笔连接起来。
content_en:
An Lian was stunned for a moment when she heard the name.

    Zhou Xiulan? Isn't she the old lady who was in front of her yesterday?

    She felt the old lady walk onto the stage tremblingly and put her hand on the crystal.

    The crystal glowed faintly, and Chen Xu reported the number: "Zhou Xiulan, the magic power is one thousand two."

    There was another commotion in the whole place.

    Not exclamation, but discussion.

    "Qian Er is also coming to participate in the trial?"

    "Isn't this a waste of quota?"

    "You're so old, wouldn't it be nice to rest at home?"

    An Lian felt uncomfortable listening to the discussions around her.

    What happened to one thousand two? Can’t you pursue your dream with only one thousand and two dollars?

    Zhou Xiulan didn't care. She walked off the stage tremblingly. When she passed by An Lian, she patted her arm again and said, "Come on."

    An Lian said "thank you" to her, feeling an indescribable emotion well up in her heart.

    "Number 24, An Lian."

    An Lian took a deep breath, stood up, and walked to the stage based on her memory and perception.

    Walking to the center of the stage, she stretched out her hand to touch the test crystal and put her palm against it.

    Magic power surged from the palm of his hand, and the crystal lit up with a warm light.

    Chen Xu glanced at the number: "An Lian, the magic value is six thousand three."

    Six thousand three, a little higher than she expected.

    An Lian retracted her hand, turned around and prepared to step off the stage.

    "Wait a minute." Chen Xu stopped her.

    An Lian stopped and turned her head in his direction: "Is something wrong, examiner?"

    Chen Xu glanced at her, hesitated to speak, and finally waved his hand: "It's okay, you can go down."

    Although An Lian was confused, she didn't think much about it and walked off the stage and returned to her seat.

    After the magic test, there is the practical practice of sealing.

    The players were taken to a large classroom next to the training ground, with a table and a set of sealing array drawing tools in front of each person.

    Chen Xu stood on the podium and announced the test questions: "Basic sealing array, there is no limit to the formation, the magic circuit is required to be complete, the nodes are clear, and the operation is stable. The time limit is thirty minutes, start now."

    An Lian picked up the pen and tried to recall the key points of drawing the sealing array.

    First draw the array base, then lay out the nodes, and finally connect the magic circuit.

    Perception came into play at this time, and she clearly "saw" the trajectory of the pen tip on the paper. The position and direction of each line were accurate to the millimeter.

    After drawing the base of the formation, she began to lay out the nodes.

    She carefully placed each node in the correct position and then connected it with a pen.
